summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results, disclosing total revenues of RMB2,703.7 million (up 37.2% YoY), an increase in AI business gross billing (90% YoY), and capital expenditures. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine earnings release triggered by the registrant's listing obligation. No special-situation category applies.
